name: Ran Bloodtooth's Skull
summary: In Ashenvale, Ran Bloodtooth's Skull reaches the night elves of Astranaar as proof that a fierce threat has fallen.

sections.title: A Trophy of Ashenvale's Defense
sections.body: Demonic taint and wilderness corruption have driven Ashenvale's furbolgs into murderous madness. Ran Bloodtooth led one of the fiercest tribes. His skull proves to the night elf Sentinels that he has fallen and his hold over the local furbolgs is broken. Astranaar gains some respite.

sections.title: Honoring the Fallen
sections.body: In Astranaar, Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner receives Ran Bloodtooth's Skull. It marks the end of an investigation begun by the fallen scout Teronis. Beside the skull rests Dartol's Rod, rebuilt after Teronis set out to find it. Together, the skull and rod honor those who fought to preserve the sacred forest.

faq.answer: Ran Bloodtooth led a corrupted furbolg tribe in Ashenvale. The night elf Sentinels counted him among the fiercest threats in the region.

faq.q: Why do the Sentinels want his skull?
aliases: why do i need the skull
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner receives Ran Bloodtooth's Skull in Astranaar as proof that he has fallen. It rests beside Dartol's Rod in memory of those lost defending Ashenvale.

Teronis was Raene Wolfrunner's longtime friend and an ally of the Sentinels in Ashenvale. He sought a gem for a rod made by the dead wizard Dartol, hoping it would slow the furbolg attacks. Murlocs slew him at Lake Falathim, so Raene Wolfrunner and visiting adventurers took up his task.

angles.text: For night elves, the skull marks a somber victory and honors Teronis's unfinished task. It also recalls how deeply demonic corruption has ravaged their former furbolg allies.
Delivering the grim trophy shows the mettle of Alliance champions defending Ashenvale's fragile borders beside the Sentinels.
